translation: Greatly toxic. It breaks masses and accumulations (症積), removes bi pain of the legs and knees (腳膝痹痛), contracture of the four limbs (四肢拘攣), malignant sores and scabies worms (惡瘡疥蟲), and kills birds and beasts. When broken, those from which blue smoke issues are named...; its heat [should be] one night; it must not enter a decoction.
